description: Three-partition synthetic topic with controllable consumer processing delay.

expected_evidence.baseline: Processing progress continues; bounded input rate is observable.
expected_evidence.slow_processing: Committed offset distance grows while processed-record progress slows.
expected_evidence.recovery: Committed offsets catch up to end offsets after delay removal.

cleanup.on_interruption: Restore the recovery delay, allow bounded producer completion, verify catch-up, then stop only child processes started by this run.
cleanup.docker_resources: Leave the named broker running for inspection; stop only kafka-ops-a2 project with the documented Compose command.
